messages.subject: Project Falcon - SPA counter-mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Amelia,

Our counter attached (tracked over your version). We've accepted the 18-month warranty and escrow periods and the £40k de minimis. On the cap we've moved to 17.5% of consideration, and raised the basket to £350k. We think that's a fair overall package and hope we can settle on this basis.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
